rendered: The strain is R82. In the prose, its yield is given as 11.4 g L^(cid:0) 1[1] of prodigiosin, about double the original strain. R82 was obtained by adaptive laboratory evolution of the strain SDSPY-136, evolved for[2] 120 generations under high osmotic pressure[3] to give the osmotic-tolerant strain R82. The fermentation scale stated in the text is[4] 5 L fed-batch fermentation[5]. Note that Table 2[6] lists the same R82 entry (SDSPY-136 to R82, adaptive laboratory evolution, time 48[7] h, titer 11,400[8] mg/L) under the cultivation mode shake flask[9], which conflicts with the fed-batch scale given in the text.
